method: Finite freezing, fixed hydrogen inlet T/P/flow and wall T. Only the indicated geometric input or mixture ratio varies. Geometry changes wall area and residence as well as expansion and mass. Hardware and controlled sweeps separately use 60s cold startup, demand60/main70, 5000kgH2+20000kgO2; sweeps use oxygenValve30 and otherwise default settings. These are game-model results, not validated engine data.
